request.text: Ossa radioed. You're building Warden kit. I can't sell you that, but I can help you make it. Strap webbing from the scrap heaps, padded liner from the wrecks, rivet stock off the droids. The bench rolls plate from scrap alloy and nanites, three and two a plate. Helm first. Two plates, a liner, two webbing, two rivets.
